title: Two-sided local sup-norm bound for g ↦ ∫_{E∩U} div g from locally finite perimeter
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N open and E ⊆ ℝ^N Lebesgue null-measurable, and suppose E has locally finite perimeter in U (SimonGMT IsLocallyBV U χ_E). Then for every compact K ⊆ U there is a constant C ≥ 0 with the following property. For every C¹ map g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ K, and every M ∈ ℝ with |g(x)| ≤ M for all x ∈ ℝ^N, we have |∫_{E∩U} div g dL^N| ≤ C · M.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn N)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → HasLocallyFinitePerimeter U E → ∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ K → ∀ M : ℝ, (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ M) → |∫ x in E ∩ U, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x| ≤ C * M
